quote_basis: Higgsfield estimate_video_cost / estimate_image_cost / estimate_audio_cost, 9:16, default resolution (720p video, 1k low-quality images) unless stated. Quotes spend nothing. Higgsfield bills clips per second with a minimum length per model. The credit-to-dollar rate depends on the Higgsfield plan and is not stated here.
rule: Best model thinks, cheap model renders. Build each ad mostly from stills (animated with pan and zoom in the edit for free); generate motion only for the beats that need it.

think.use_for: hooks, scripts, comedy timing, lyrics, shot prompts, carousel copy, QA
think.model: Claude (the Wizard Agent itself, best available model)

still.use_for: every still frame, carousel slide art, start frames for clips. Pan and zoom are added in the edit at no cost.
still.upgrade: quality high = 1.5 credits per image, ask first

real_photo.use_for: testimonials, before/after, real staff, real customers, real performances. Client-supplied photo or footage only, never generated.

text_only.use_for: kinetic text, captions over a color or blurred background, assembled in the edit

clip_draft.use_for: previews and simple motion (zoom, pan, small action)

clip_standard.use_for: default final motion beats, image-to-video from a still

clip_hero.use_for: one premium shot per ad, only when the client approves the spend
clip_hero.evidence: 3s = 9, 5s = 15 credits. Its default length is 10s (30 credits), so always pass duration.

talking_head.use_for: client clone / presenter speaking to camera (lip-sync)
talking_head.note: Not quoted: the quote needs a real voice recording. The validator budgets 10 credits per beat as a reserve; quote the real cost per job before generating.

music.use_for: jingles, sung hooks, beds for songwriting templates (custom lyrics)
music.alt: Suno (on the user's own Suno plan), then the suno-mix skill for the mix

carousel.use_for: turning a template's slides into an editable branded carousel
carousel.model: Canva create-design / autofill-design with the client's brand kit
carousel.note: Slide art reuses the stills. Canva's own AI features depend on the user's Canva plan and are not quoted here.

budgets.note: The validator enforces these on the final render of one ad: every still, clip, talking-head reserve, music and carousel slide. Draft previews are extra and are quoted separately before a batch.
